archetypes.name: dyn-module-split
archetypes.rationale: Verify cross-module imports and re-export completeness
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that all functions accessed in test_analyze_issues.py via analyze_issues.X are re-exported from the new analyze_issues.py wrapper. Verify no circular imports between _util, _report, _oos, _ground_truth. Confirm complexity-baseline.json covers the new module files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
